TITLE: Privacy and Security Policy of AM Finance
SECTION_1_CONTENT: AM Finance ("AM Finance", "We") is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data. This Privacy and Security Policy ("Policy") clearly and transparently explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your information when using our Services, in full compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law No. 13,709/2018) and best practices in information security.
SECTION_2_TITLE: 2.0 Collection and Processing of Personal Data
SECTION_2_INTRO: To provide our Services, we need to process some of your personal data. The LGPD requires that this processing be justified by a legal basis and that you be informed about it transparently. The table below summarizes the main data processing activities we perform:
SECTION_2_REGISTRY_PURPOSE: Create, authenticate, and manage your User Account; Send essential transactional communications (e.g., payment confirmation, security notices); Provide technical support.
SECTION_2_REGISTRY_LEGAL: Item V: Execution of contract or preliminary procedures related to contract.
SECTION_2_FINANCIAL_EXAMPLES: Descriptions, amounts, dates, and categories of transactions (expenses, income); Account balance (if informed by User).
SECTION_2_FINANCIAL_PURPOSE: Constitutes the core of Services: record, categorize, analyze, and present your financial information; Generate personalized reports, charts, and insights in your dashboard.
SECTION_2_PAYMENT_EXAMPLES: Subscription status (active, canceled, delinquent), due date. We do not store credit card data.
SECTION_2_PAYMENT_PURPOSE: Manage access to Services based on your subscription status.
SECTION_2_NAVIGATION_EXAMPLES: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, access logs, pages visited, time spent, cookies.
SECTION_2_NAVIGATION_PURPOSE: Ensure Platform security (fraud and attack prevention); Monitor technical performance and stability of Services; Analyze Platform usage to identify improvements and develop new features.
SECTION_2_NAVIGATION_LEGAL: Item IX: When necessary to serve the legitimate interests of the controller.
SECTION_2_COMMUNICATION_EXAMPLES: Content of messages exchanged with our assistant via WhatsApp and with our support team via email or other channels.
SECTION_2_COMMUNICATION_PURPOSE: Provide User support, answer questions, and resolve issues; Maintain a record of interactions for quality, audit, and security purposes.
SECTION_3_1_CONTENT: Our interaction with you via WhatsApp uses the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API, provided by Meta. This ensures that messages are processed securely and in a standardized manner. AM Finance only processes the content of messages you send to us through our official number for the purpose of providing Services (e.g., recording an expense). We do not have access to any other conversations or data from your WhatsApp.
SECTION_3_2_CONTENT: As detailed in the Terms of Use, we use a specialized payment gateway with PCI DSS certification to process your subscriptions. This ensures that your payment data is processed with the highest level of security, without it passing through or being stored on our servers.
SECTION_4_INTRO: We take the security of your data very seriously and implement a set of technical and administrative measures to protect it against unauthorized access and accidental or illicit situations.
SECTION_4_1_SUBTITLE: Encryption is a fundamental layer of our security strategy.
SECTION_4_1_TRANSIT_CONTENT: All communication between your browser or WhatsApp application and our servers is protected with Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL) encryption, the same standard used by banks and e-commerce services.
SECTION_4_1_REST_CONTENT: All your personal and financial information stored in our databases and in our backups is protected with strong encryption algorithms, such as AES-256. This means that, even in an unlikely scenario of physical access to our servers, the data would remain unreadable.
SECTION_4_2_CONTENT: We implement strict access control policies to ensure that only authorized AM Finance employees have access to your data, and only when strictly necessary for support provision or system maintenance. Access is based on the principle of least privilege, and all access activities are logged and monitored.
SECTION_4_3_CONTENT: Our partnership with a PCI DSS-compliant payment gateway ensures that financial transactions are processed according to the highest security standards in the payment industry.
SECTION_4_4_CONTENT: Our systems are continuously monitored to detect suspicious activities and potential vulnerabilities. We perform regular and encrypted backups of all data, which are stored in geographically distinct locations to ensure availability and integrity of information in case of failures.
SECTION_5_INTRO: Despite all our efforts, no system is 100% immune to risks. Therefore, we maintain a Security Incident Response Plan to act quickly and effectively in case an adverse event occurs. Transparency about this process is a pillar of the trust we want to build with you.
SECTION_5_1_CONTENT: A security incident with personal data is any event, accidental or malicious, that results in unauthorized access, destruction, loss, alteration, or leakage of personal data under our control.
SECTION_5_2_INTRO: If an incident is detected, our protocol provides for the following steps:
SECTION_5_2_STEP_1_CONTENT: Our technical team will act immediately to identify the nature of the incident and take the necessary measures to contain it, limiting any potential damage.
SECTION_5_2_STEP_2_CONTENT: We will conduct a careful assessment to determine the extent of the incident, the types of data affected, and, crucially, whether the event may result in "relevant risk or damage" to data subjects, according to LGPD criteria.
SECTION_5_2_STEP_3_CONTENT: If the assessment concludes that the incident presents a relevant risk to you, we have a legal and ethical commitment to notify the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) and affected data subjects within a reasonable time. The communication will describe the nature of the affected data, the risks involved, and the measures we are taking to mitigate the effects of the incident, as required by Article 48 of the LGPD.
SECTION_5_2_STEP_4_CONTENT: After resolving the incident, we will conduct an in-depth investigation to identify the root cause and implement corrective and preventive measures to further strengthen our security and prevent recurrence of the event.
SECTION_6_INTRO: The LGPD grants you a series of rights over your personal data. AM Finance respects and facilitates the exercise of these rights. At any time, you may request:
SECTION_6_RIGHT_1: Confirmation of the existence of processing of your data.
SECTION_6_RIGHT_3: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
SECTION_6_RIGHT_4: Anonymization, blocking, or elimination of unnecessary, excessive, or processed data in non-compliance with the LGPD.
SECTION_6_RIGHT_5: Portability of your data to another service provider, upon express request.
SECTION_6_RIGHT_6: Elimination of personal data processed with your consent.
SECTION_6_RIGHT_7: Information about public and private entities with which we share data.
SECTION_7_CONTENT: This Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legislation. When we make material changes, we will notify you by email, through the Platform, or via WhatsApp, and update the "Last Update" date at the top of this document. We recommend that you review this Policy regularly.
